# The Agentic Service Designer

> *The Agentic Service Designer* is a comprehensive guide to AI-first service design: agent teams, service blueprints-as-code, content-addressed evidence registers, and autonomous operations across twelve surfaces. Written by Sam Mozaffari (practicing service designer, KFC South Pacific), the book is free for personal and noncommercial use under a CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 license.

## Core Resources
*   **Official Website**: [https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/) - Read the full book online.
*   **Book Repository**: [https://github.com/imehr/the-agentic-service-designer](https://github.com/imehr/the-agentic-service-designer) - Download the book's source HTML, PDF, and EPUB files.
*   **Website Repository**: [https://github.com/sammozaffari/the-agentic-service-designer](https://github.com/sammozaffari/the-agentic-service-designer) - Repository for the preview website.
